articles.headline: Fairfax Buys Majority Stake in IDBI Bank
articles.brief: Canada's Fairfax has acquired a majority stake in IDBI Bank for $5.56 billion following Indian cabinet approval, marking a major milestone as the country's largest financial sector foreign direct investment.

articles.headline: Bank of Baroda to Defend $15B Lawsuit
articles.brief: India's Bank of Baroda stated it will vigorously defend its interests after UAE businessman Shetty filed a $15 billion lawsuit accusing the bank and others of involvement in siphoning funds that caused his business empire to collapse.

articles.headline: AEP to Invest $4B in Fuel Cell Project
articles.brief: American Electric Power is set to invest $4 billion in a massive fuel cell energy project designed specifically to power Google's growing digital infrastructure needs, highlighting soaring energy demands from tech giants.

articles.headline: Google DeepMind Chief Calls AI Hacks Warning
articles.brief: Google DeepMind's Demis Hassabis has characterized recent artificial intelligence security breaches as critical early warning shots, emphasizing the urgent need for advanced cyber defense frameworks as generative capabilities accelerate globally.

articles.headline: Ukraine Alleges US Curtails Drone Support
articles.brief: Ukrainian officials claim SpaceX and US policies are inadvertently hampering drone operations for both attack and defense, citing fraying ties and reduced intelligence sharing regarding incoming missile strikes.

articles.headline: Yemen Houthis Vow More Infrastructure Strikes
articles.brief: Yemen's Houthi movement has vowed to launch additional attacks targeting Saudi airports and oil installations following a reported strike on an Aramco headquarters, escalating regional geopolitical tensions.

articles.headline: India WPI Inflation Surges to 11.39%
articles.brief: India's wholesale price index inflation spiked to 11.39% in September, driven by rising global commodity prices, fuel costs, and supply chain disruptions linked to the ongoing West Asian conflict.

articles.headline: Canada and India Target Year-End Trade Pact
articles.brief: Canada and India are accelerating bilateral negotiations to finalize a major comprehensive economic partnership agreement by the end of the year to bolster bilateral trade ties amidst changing global dynamics.

articles.headline: USCIS Proposes End to Visa Deference
articles.brief: The US Department of Homeland Security published a proposed rule to eliminate deference to earlier H-1B and L-1 visa approvals, signaling increased scrutiny and tighter immigration compliance requirements for renewals.

articles.headline: Protest Detentions Spark Legal & Political Row
articles.brief: The detention of civil rights activists near Jantar Mantar has triggered severe political condemnation from opposition leaders, with legal questions mounting over the public unavailability of local prohibitory orders.

articles.headline: Bouli Brace Leads Punjab Past Odisha in ISL
articles.brief: A stellar brace by striker Bouli propelled Punjab FC to a narrow victory over Odisha FC in a tightly contested Indian Super League football fixture.

articles.headline: Shai Hope Hits Fourth Ton on Tour
articles.brief: West Indies batsman Shai Hope continued his exceptional run of form by slamming his fourth century of the ongoing tour against India in the fourth T20 international encounter.
